headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty extended gains for third straight week as FII buying supported Indian equities.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Sensex and Nifty extended gains for a third straight week supported by foreign institutional investor (FII) buying.
Market sentiment was aided by positive Q2 earnings and an AI retreat fueling a rotation trade into Indian stocks.
In the last session on Friday, benchmark indices dipped with Sensex slipping 289 points due to inflation concerns.
Global market cues and GIFT Nifty signals influenced daily trading trends across recent sessions.
whatHappening: Indian equity markets recorded their third consecutive week of gains despite global headwinds such as the Nvidia crisis.
Sensex and Nifty experienced a pullback on Friday as inflation worries weighed on investor sentiment.
Multiple companies including Ashok Leyland, Powergrid, Cochin Shipyard, and PFC are scheduled for corporate actions and dividends.
FII inflows boosted Indian equities mid-week following strong Q2 corporate earnings performance.
summary: Indian markets extended gains for the third straight week driven by FII buying and strong Q2 earnings. However, in the last trading session on Friday, Sensex fell 289 points as inflation concerns weighed on sentiment. Investors are watching corporate actions and dividend announcements in stocks like Ashok Leyland, Powergrid, and PFC.
